question: A hemisphere and cylinder of equal radii have equal total surface areas. Find the ratio of cylinder height to radius.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Hemisphere = 3πr²

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Cylinder = 2πr(h + r)

Equating both: 3πr² = 2πr(h + r)

⇒ 3r = 2h + 2r ⇒ r = 2h

⇒ h/r = 1/2

**∴ The correct answer is 1:2.**
